title: Figure 3: Inside-out whirling dense matter torus - dipole gravitational field generator
description: Stippled line drawing of a thick torus with curved arrows showing matter rotating inside-out like a smoke ring, labeled with vectors "Mv" (mass motion) and "a" (upward acceleration) at the center.
